entries.title: Psalms 79:1
segments: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple; they have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

entries.title: Psalms 79:2
segments: They have given the dead bodies of Your servants [as] food for the birds of the heavens, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 79:3
segments: They have shed their blood like water round about Jerusalem, and none to bury.

entries.title: Psalms 79:4
segments: We have become a shame to our neighbors, a scorn and mockery to those who are around us.

entries.title: Psalms 79:5
segments: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Shall Your jealousy burn like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 79:6
segments: Pour out Your wrath on the nations who have not known You, and on the kingdoms who have not called on Your name.

entries.title: Psalms 79:7
segments: For [they have] eaten up Jacob, and wasted his dwelling-place.

entries.title: Psalms 79:8
segments: O do not remember against us our former sins; let Your tender mercies meet us quickly; for we are brought very low.

entries.title: Psalms 79:9
segments: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; and deliver us, and atone for our sins, for Your name's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 79:10
segments: Why should the nations say, Where [is] their God? Let Him be known among the nations before our eyes [by] the revenging of the blood of Your servants [which is] shed.

entries.title: Psalms 79:11
segments: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; according to the greatness of Your power, leave a remnant of those who are to die,

entries.title: Psalms 79:12
segments: and give to our neighbors their curse sevenfold into their bosom, the curse with which they have cursed You, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 79:13
segments: Then we, Your people and sheep of Your pasture, will give You thanks forever; we will show forth Your praise to all generations.
